problem: The paraphrase is confusing: 「除非收到才不寄」 is roughly what the Unless sentence does mean, so saying 'it is not that' muddles the point; Unless would mean a new one ships only if the old one is NOT received.
fix: 文法可以，但語意變成「沒收到舊機才寄新機」，不合理

problem: Intransitivity is not the reason: 'enroll' is also intransitive in 'To enroll, visit...'; 'To occur, visit...' is grammatical and fails only on meaning.
fix: 文法可以，但語意不通：occur 是「發生」，不是報名

problem: 'build a market' is a normal collocation and a market could employ 300 people; the option fails only because a frozen-meal maker needs a production facility.
fix: build a market 文法可以，但做冷凍餐要蓋的是工廠

problem: 'appreciated' means 'valued/thanked' (被感謝的); '感激的' is the meaning of 'appreciative', so the gloss swaps the two words.
'週底' is not standard Taiwan usage for 'the end of the week'.
fix: 請在本週結束前付清餘額

problem: The Chinese paraphrase is backwards: 「除非晚到才要通知」 (only if late, notify) is the correct If meaning; 'Unless you plan to arrive after 10' means notify us only if you are NOT arriving late.
fix: 文法可以，但語意變成「不晚到才要通知」，相反
